sloka: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः श्रुत्वा रामस्य शासनम्।अभिपेतुः सुसङ्क्रुद्धाः कुम्भमुद्यतकार्मुकम् ।। ६.७६.५९ ।।
transliteration: te tu vānaraśārdūlāḥ śrutvā rāmasya śāsanam।abhipetuḥ susaṅkruddhāḥ kumbhamudyatakārmukam ।। 6.76.59 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Rama's command, the enraged Vanara tigers took up bows to attack Kumbha.
